properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 14 at 2:06AM MDT until October 15 at 12:00PM MDT by NWS Cheyenne WY
properties.description:
...SEASON'S FIRST WINTER STORM TO IMPACT THE SIERRA MADRE, SNOWY, AND
SOUTHERN LARAMIE RANGES...

.An upper level system will drift eastward and produce accumulating
snow at elevations above 7000 feet through Thursday evening.
Favorable upslope flow from the north to northeast at the Snowy
Ranges are forecasted to produce snow accumulations of 6 to 12 inches
through Thursday evening. As the system center moves east, winds
shift out of a more northerly direction favorable for snow on the
Sierra Madre Ranges starting overnight Wednesday. Snow levels are
expected to reach the I-80 Summit of the Southern Laramie Ranges
early Wednesday morning. Locally heavier snow totals are possible in
the advisory zones.

* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 3 and 6
inches, mainly above 7000 ft in elevation. Winds gusting as high as
35 mph.

* WHERE...South Laramie Range including the Interstate 80 Summit
between Cheyenne and Laramie, and North Snowy Range Foothills
including Arlington and Elk Mountain along Interstate 80.

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to noon MDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Outdoor recreation could
become dangerous to those caught unprepared for hazardous winter
conditions.
properties.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. The latest road conditions
for the state you are calling from can be obtained by calling 5 1 1.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 14 at 4:17PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
Invest 96W is currently rated as "High" for development by the Joint
Typhoon Warning Center, and is the subject of a Tropical Cyclone
Formation Alert, meaning development into a significant tropical
cyclone (a tropical depression) is expected within 24 hours. 96W is
currently located northeast of Pohnpei near 8.7N 160.7E, and
continues to develop and strengthen just north of the region.
Convergent fresh to strong westerlies south of 96W's center are
producing bands of scattered to numerous showers capable of strong
gusts and locally heavy rainfall, across Kosrae, Pohnpei, and their
adjacent coastal waters. Ensemble model guidance suggests rainfall
amounts of 2 to 4 inches will be possible for Pohnpei through late
Friday night as 96W strengthens and passes north of the island, with
an additional 1 to 2 inches possible for Kosrae through early
Thursday morning as conditions start to ease there. Gusts to 30 knots
will be possible near heavier showers.

Gusty winds and elevated, choppy seas will make marine conditions
hazardous to small craft, and inter-island travel is discouraged.
Keep up to date with the latest information from the National Weather
Service in Tiyan, Guam, and your local emergency management.

properties.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 13 at 9:57PM MST until October 14 at 8:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 29 expected.

* WHERE...Coconino Plateau, Grand Canyon Country, Kaibab Plateau, and
Western Mogollon Rim for elevations primarily above 6000 feet.

* WHEN...Until 8 AM MST /9 AM MDT/ Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Freezing temperatures will kill sensitive vegetation.
Unprotected outdoor plumbing and in-ground sprinkler systems will
also be at risk.
properties.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

To prevent freezing and possible bursting of outdoor water pipes,
they should be wrapped, drained, or allowed to drip slowly.

Those that have in-ground sprinkler systems should drain them and
cover above-ground pipes to protect them from freezing.

properties.description:
AQABMX

The Alabama Department of Environmental Management, ADEM, has issued
an Air Quality Alert for Jefferson and Shelby Counties for
Wednesday, October 14.

Under Code Orange conditions, ground level ozone concentrations are
expected to reach levels that are unhealthy for sensitive groups.
Children and people with asthma are individuals most at risk under
these expected conditions.

ADEM recommends the following actions during an air quality alert
for ozone:

Conserve electricity and set your air conditioner at a higher
temperature.

Limit driving and combine errands.

Use the bus or car pool to work.

Avoid use of gasoline powered lawn and garden equipment.

Refuel cars and trucks after 6 PM.

Limit engine idling.

Use household, workshop, and garden chemicals in ways that keep
evaporation to a minimum, or try to avoid them when poor air quality
is forecast.

If breathing becomes difficult, move indoors.

For more information on what to do on an air quality alert day,
visit the Environmental Protection Agency website at airnow.gov
properties.note: Non-Weather Emergency Message. Not sent to IPAWS.

properties.description:
ESFGUM

This Hydrologic Outlook is for Guam, Rota, Tinian, and Saipan.

Invest 96W is still a broad, disorganized disturbance located about
300 miles north of Kosrae. Ensemble model guidance continues to show
a passage anywhere between south of Guam to north of Saipan as a
tropical storm or typhoon. Uncertainty is still high regarding
timing, location, and intensity, but the potential for locally heavy
rainfall and flooding continues to increase approaching this weekend.

This is expected to produce 5 to 8 inches of rainfall between
Saturday and Monday, with localized amounts up to 12 inches possible.

As showers are likely to persist, consistent rainfall is likely to
saturate the soils enough to increase chance for mudslides.

Residents on these islands need to closely monitor this developing
situation as flood watches, advisories and flash flood warnings could
be issued later this weekend.

If living near streams and rivers, prepare to move items away from
stream and river banks. Make sure storm drains nearby are not
clogged, especially If living at low-lying areas.
